title: Harbor and Summer
author: Ulyana Ravensworth
blurb: Hazel Montrose, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
